Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro (via Ben last week). ClearBridge is looking to accelerate a pilot around summarization and assisted search for our internal analytics workflows; we'd like to align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a pragmatic evaluation plan so we can hit a procurement target in Q3.

High-level asks from our side:
- Kickoff to align stakeholders and timelines (60 min).
- Evaluation criteria: latency targets (~<200ms median), throughput (batch sizes), hallucination tolerance / precision metrics, and a short user-acceptance rubric.
- A small eval dataset we can run locally (10–20 representative prompts).

Our core stakeholders who should join the kickoff: myself (Solutions Lead), Mark Han (CTO), and Priya Singh (Data Eng). We prefer the week of Jul 12 or Jul 14 — both mornings PT work for us.

Can you share your MAP template and a draft agenda? Also let us know who from Redwood will own the evaluation plan and who will run the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Alicia
